newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state extends share offer.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state extends share offer.

text.p: Egypt's state Holding Company for Chemical Industries said on Thursday it was extending the deadline for bids for more than 1.3 million shares in Pachin/Paints and Chemical Industries.
The company said in an announcement in al-Ahram newspaper that the offer would now end at 1000 GMT on January 9 to give more investors a chance to bid after New Year holidays.
The original deadline for the bids was December 25.
A spokesman for the agents of the offer said on Monday the offer was subscribed more than twice over.
The holding company, which owns 87.5 percent of the 10 million shares in Pachin, had offered 1.3125 million shares by auction at a minimum price of 137.99 pounds a share.
